subject: Evidence handoff: SOC 2 + SIG pack and VPC control matrix
messages:
From: Harriet Lawson <harriet@mediplus.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@mediplus.com
Date: 2026-05-12T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 + SIG answers and VPC controls for EU pilot

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As we scope the EU pilot for MediPlus, our security team has asked for three items before the next procurement step: a recent SOC 2 report (Type 2), a filled SIG/CAIQ-style response matrix, and a simple VPC control matrix that shows private endpoint topology and tenancy boundaries for EU-only deployments.

Can you confirm timeline for providing the documents and whether we can get a short mapping that highlights which controls are addressed by your private deployment (VPC + KMS partitioning)? We’d like to circulate to procurement by EOD Friday.

Best,
Harriet
Head of IT Risk, MediPlus

--
Attachment: request-checklist.pdf (1 page summary)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Harriet Lawson <harriet@mediplus.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 + SIG answers and VPC controls for EU pilot

Hi Harriet — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide the SOC 2 Type 2 report and a completed SIG-style matrix, and we’ll include a concise VPC control matrix that maps to the MediPlus requirements for EU-only hosting.

Plan/Timing:
- SOC 2 (redacted): attached PDF (will send official redacted copy via secure Drive link).
- SIG matrix: we’ll attach the XLSX with per-question notes; Kimberly will own any follow-ups on items marked "partial".
- VPC control matrix: CSV attached showing private endpoint, region routing policy, KMS partition notes, and fallback behavior.

Next steps: Kimberly, can you review the VPC matrix and add any operator contact info before EOD? Sean — please add a short note on rollback/fallback policy for regional outages (1-2 bullets) and I’ll push the Drive links to Harriet.

Rachel
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf (redacted), SOC2-cover-note.txt

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Harriet Lawson <harriet@mediplus.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-13T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 + SIG answers and VPC controls for EU pilot

Hi all — uploaded the SIG/CAIQ responses and the VPC control matrix. A few callouts inside the matrix:

- Network topology: EU pilot uses dedicated VPCs in eu-west-1 with private endpoints. We include peering to a dedicated NAT/egress appliance in the same region; egress is restricted by customer-configured outbound rules.
- KMS separation: Customer keys are supported via a customer-controlled KMS (BYOK) or our dedicated tenant partitioning with separate CMKs. See row KMS-05 in the CSV for specifics.
- Operator contacts: listed column H with on-call rotation and SRE escalation playbook link.
- Partial controls: a small set of SIG items related to vendor-hosted logging retention are marked 'partial' because we recommend integrating MediPlus’ forwarder into the Redwoods logging pipeline for full retention parity.

Sean — included a short fallback note in the VPC CSV (final column). Harriet — I also attached the formal Excel with per-question notes that your security team requested.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Cloud Security PM, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: SIG_Response_Matrix_May2026.xlsx, vpc-control-matrix-2026.csv

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Harriet Lawson <harriet@mediplus.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-14T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 + SIG answers and VPC controls for EU pilot

Hi Harriet — quick operational note to complement the docs:

- Failover behavior: primary serving in eu-west-1; automatic regional fallback to eu-central-1 only if customer policy allows cross-region failover. We default to "no cross-region fallback" for EU residency-sensitive deployments unless explicitly enabled in the Dedicated/Private onboarding form.
- KV/cache eviction: per-tenant KV caches are never egressed to other regions. That is enforced in runtime routing.
- Onboarding checklist: we will run a brief network validation (privatelink handshake + traceroute) during provisioning and provide a signed connectivity snapshot for procurement.

If you want a short one-page summary for procurement, say the word and I’ll drop it in the Drive link.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Reliability, Redwood Inference
